items.title: US to end military aid to Iraqi Kurdistan, raising Iran attack fears
items.title_zh: 五角大楼拟不续签对库尔德佩什梅格军援备忘录，9月30日到期
items.summary_zh: BBC：四名知情人士称，国防部近期告知伊拉克库尔德斯坦领导人，不打算续签向佩什梅格提供安全援助的谅解备忘录；备忘录9月30日到期，同一天美方及其他国家从伊拉克撤出最后一批部队，埃尔比勒美军基地也将关闭。佩什梅格约18万人，2026财年经五角大楼打IS项目获得约6100万美元武器、训练与津贴；2027财年预算草案拟全部砍掉，国会预算战仍未落地。捍卫民主基金会统计，截至5月下旬伊朗及亲伊民兵已在伊拉克库尔德斯坦发动158次导弹或无人机袭击。2016年签署、2022年续签的备忘录是否保留部分支持仍在审议；美国去年12月刚在埃尔比勒启用造价约8亿美元、号称全球最大的领事馆。

quotes.author: Yerevan Saeed
quotes.en: The US would be cutting off the Kurds, who shed so much blood to help the Americans achieve their goals in Iraq and the wider Middle East.
quotes.zh: 美国等于切断库尔德人——他们流了那么多血，才帮美国人在伊拉克和更广大的中东达成目标。

items.title: StemDeck, a free, open-source and local AI stem separator
items.title_zh: StemDeck：免费开源、本地运行的AI分轨工具
items.summary_zh: StemDeck是给音乐人和爱好者用的本地分轨桌面应用：拖入MP3/WAV/FLAC等，或粘贴YouTube链接，把音频拆成最多六轨（人声、鼓、贝斯、吉他、钢琴、其他），再在类似DAW的混音器里静音、独奏、导出。作者强调不设账号、不上传、不订阅，自称Moises、LALAL.AI一类云分轨的开源替代。HN上199赞、58评。评论区有人拿它和Nuo Stems、Audacity的OpenVINO插件对比，也有人提醒它未必是新模型。

quotes.author: Stitch4223
quotes.en:
For dj use I recommend Nuo Stems, as it integrates with dj software. But you don’t need it if you only want to play with the models behind it.

That’s because it uses mel_band_roformer and bs_roformer which are really great stem separation models (i haven’t heard anything better yet).

Their page about stem separation quality is a nice place to start if you want to dive into these types of models: https://docs.nuo-stems.com/docs/stems-separation-quality
quotes.zh:
做DJ的话我推荐Nuo Stems，因为它能跟DJ软件对接。但如果你只是想玩后面的模型，就不需要它。

因为它用的是mel_band_roformer和bs_roformer，分轨效果非常好（我还没听过更好的）。

他们关于分轨质量的页面是入门这类模型的好起点：https://docs.nuo-stems.com/docs/stems-separation-quality

quotes.author: tomduncalf
quotes.en: It still blows my mind that this is possible, as someone who spent a lot of time as a kid trying and failing to get “acapellas” by EQing or subtracting instrumentals from vocal versions haha
quotes.zh: 这至今还让我吃惊。我小时候花了很多时间，试图用EQ或把伴奏从人声版里减出来做“清唱轨”，基本都失败了，哈哈。

items.title: Zelenskyy Vows Up to 1,000 Daily Drone Strikes on Russian Targets
items.title_zh: 泽连斯基要求把对俄远程无人机打击从日均逾300架提高到1000架
items.summary_zh: 《基辅独立报》：泽连斯基8月28日晚间讲话把优先事项定为加强对喷气式Shahed的防御，并把对俄纵深打击加密。他说当前日均超过300次远程打击，“任务是每天1000架对俄远程无人机”，目标明确、将会达到。他称俄方已出现更少汽油、更少出口、更少物流，并首次进口汽油、用预算补贴石油公司。总参谋部确认8月28日打击雅罗斯拉夫尔的斯拉夫涅夫特-YANOS炼厂（俄最大炼油设施之一），并称恩格斯基地一架图-95受损；8月26日对下诺夫哥罗德Kstovo的卢克石油NORSI炼厂打击后，该厂停止原油加工。《明镜》同期引述同一讲话，称乌方已让对黑海舰队重要的新罗西斯克港陷入瘫痪。

quotes.author: Volodymyr Zelensky
quotes.en: The task is a thousand drones for long-range strikes against Russia every day. Right now, the average is over 300 of our long-range strikes, there must be more. We have a very specific goal, and we will achieve it.
quotes.zh: 任务是每天1000架对俄远程打击无人机。现在我们平均每天超过300次远程打击，必须再多。我们有非常具体的目标，我们会达到。

items.fetch_notes: NM listed spiegel.de; used Kyiv Independent English original of the Aug 28 evening address. Spiegel German match confirmed (1000/day, currently >300; Novorossiysk port).

items.title: TurboKV: Insanely fast Rust key-value store
items.summary_zh: TurboKV是Rust异步嵌入式键值库：原子批量写、有序范围/前缀扫描、LZ4等压缩、后台compaction，以及fast/durable/paranoid三档耐久预设。README写明durable是追加WAL、不在每次写入时sync，进程崩溃可恢复，断电要等刷盘检查点；paranoid才在确认前做sync_all。持久化Bloom过滤器用硬件AES。HN上169赞、83评。标题里的“Insanely fast”被指是提交者加的，仓库自己只称fast。

quotes.author: dangoodmanUT
quotes.en:
> DbOptions::durable()

> Appended to the WAL without a per-write sync

So… it’s not durable? Durable doesn’t mean “survives a process restart”, it means “durably saved to persistent storage”. For example, this “durable” mode wouldn’t survive power loss.
quotes.zh:
> DbOptions::durable()

> 追加到WAL，每次写入不做sync

所以……这并不durable？Durable不是“进程重启还能活”，而是“耐久地写到持久存储”。比如这个“durable”模式就扛不住断电。

quotes.author: KAdot
quotes.en: The benchmark is setup to test 80 MiB dataset on a machine with 32 GiB RAM, which doesn't represent a typical database workload. How does the key-value store perform on larger than RAM datasets? MMAP is fast when the dataset fits in memory, but it can slow to a crawl when it doesn't, especially if the workload is mostly random point lookups.
quotes.zh: 基准测试是在32 GiB内存的机器上测80 MiB数据集，这不代表典型数据库负载。大于内存的数据集上这个键值库表现如何？数据能装进内存时MMAP很快，装不下就会慢成爬，尤其是负载以随机点查为主的时候。

items.title: SpaceX recovers Starship from Indian Ocean, ships it back to Texas
items.title_zh: SpaceX从印度洋回收星舰40号，半潜船Forte已离圣诞岛运回得州
items.summary_zh: 澳大利亚广播公司：SpaceX星舰40号7月24日在印度洋溅落，在海上漂了24天后被拖到西澳以北约1500公里的圣诞岛，是SpaceX首枚完整幸存的上级火箭，长约52米。半潜运输船Forte上周五下午离开圣诞岛，驶向得州Starbase，航程约2万公里、预计数周。船员先给压载舱注水把甲板压到水面以下，再由当地码头工人把箭体对准甲板后起浮。美联社称这是第13次完整星舰试飞、也是迄今最大打捞。悉尼大学海洋机器人教授Stefan Williams指出，这类大船日费可观，打捞加跨洋运输成本会很快堆起来；SpaceX目标是把火箭送回发射场重复使用。

quotes.author: Stefan Williams
quotes.en: There's a significant cost involved, both in rescue operations and also in the transport of the equipment from where it's been retrieved, in this case back to the home base in the US.
quotes.zh: 无论是救援作业，还是把设备从打捞地点运回——这次是运回美国本土基地——成本都相当可观。

items.fetch_notes: NM listed abcnews.com; AP recovery write-up lacked salvage numbers. Used ABC Australia original (Ship 40, Forte, ~20,000 km).

items.title: Tencent Releases and Open-Sources Tencent Hy4 Preview
items.title_zh: 腾讯发布并开源混元Hy4预览版
items.summary_zh: 腾讯：Hy4 preview总参数770B、激活49B，上下文超过100万token，面向编程、办公和科研，开源权重，并可通过WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy、元宝、ima以及TokenHub、OpenRouter调用。公司称内部163名专家、203个工程任务盲评均分2.99/4.00，略高于GLM-5.3的2.92；还写模型首次参与训练方法、数据和算子的自动优化，并称自优化把推理吞吐相对基线提高31.8%。API标价约每百万输入0.834美元、输出2.501美元。HN上164赞、100评。

quotes.author: minimaxir
quotes.en: Hy4 apparently has ludicrous traction on OpenRouter already (https://openrouter.ai/tencent/hy4-preview), with trillions of tokens processed in a couple days: more than GLM 5.3 in a week. That said, it's relatively cheap with a 5% cache cost when everyone is still doing 10%/20% cache costs, so Hy4 may be more compelling.
quotes.zh: Hy4在OpenRouter上的用量已经夸张（https://openrouter.ai/tencent/hy4-preview），几天里跑了数万亿token：比GLM 5.3一周还多。不过它相对便宜，缓存命中只要5%，别人还在收10%/20%，所以Hy4可能更有吸引力。

quotes.author: fastball
quotes.en:
I wish model providers would stop committing chart crimes in their releases.

- if you're gonna order the rest of the bar chart by rank, order your model accordingly.

- if you're gonna highlight a winner in a table of benchmarks, don't highlight your entire model row in the table.

Etc etc
quotes.zh:
希望模型厂商发布时别再犯图表罪了。

- 如果你按排名给其余柱子排序，也把自己的模型按同样规则排。

- 如果你要在基准表里高亮赢家，别整行都涂上自己的模型。

诸如此类。

items.title: Walmart settles US opioid lawsuit with Justice Department
items.title_zh: 沃尔玛以5000万美元和解美国司法部阿片类药物诉讼，不承认责任
items.summary_zh: 路透社：司法部周五称，沃尔玛将支付5000万美元，了结2020年12月提起、指控其药店违法配发处方、助推全美阿片危机的联邦诉讼。起诉曾称民事罚金可能高达数十亿美元；沃尔玛不承认责任，监管文件称和解金额“不重大”——公司截至7月31日的六个月净利为117亿美元。司法部指控其自2013年起多次违反《受控物质法》，未追踪、未报告可疑阿片处方，部分合规人员明知开方者是“药丸作坊”仍配药。和解还要求加强对药剂师的监督，并设立供员工与患者举报非法配发的热线。2022年沃尔玛曾向州与地方政府支付31亿美元和解同类诉讼；特拉华州威尔明顿联邦法院周四提交了撤诉联合约定。疾控中心统计，1999至2025年美国超过90.5万人死于阿片过量。

quotes.author: Stanley Woodward
quotes.en: Today's settlement proves this department is committed to putting Americans' flourishing first.
quotes.zh: 今天的和解证明，本部门致力于把美国人的福祉放在首位。

items.title: SQLite as a Document Database (2020)
items.summary_zh: dgl.cx 2020年旧文再次上首页：SQLite 3.31起有生成列，可用json_extract从TEXT里的JSON抽出字段并建索引，等于把嵌入式库当文档库。插入时走json()或生成列，畸形JSON会在INSERT时报错；VIRTUAL列可后加，STORED列不能用ALTER TABLE补。作者举例从只有body一列开始，再按webhook里用到的键逐步加列和索引。HN上160赞、43评。

quotes.author: stanac
quotes.en:
I am using SQLite as document db for a side project for years now. Made a custom repository base class that can also store blobs in separate columns, so this type of data is not part of the json document. Today there is also jsonb [1], as far as I remember all functions work the same for json and jsonb.

Also the repo class stores write and delete timestamps as separate columns so I can have CDC. CDC is used for building cached view models and is pushed to object storage every 5 minutes for backup as NDJSON. Another process on home server is restoring the db every couple of minutes for second backup and ready to use DB in case it's needed.

I know there are things like Litestream, I wanted something in process and something that can send alerts on failed backups.

[1] https://sqlite.org/jsonb.html
quotes.zh:
我把SQLite当文档库用在一个副业项目上已经好几年了。自己写了个仓库基类，也能把blob存到单独列，这样这类数据不进JSON文档。现在还有jsonb[1]，我记得所有函数对json和jsonb都一样。

仓库类还把写入和删除时间戳存成单独列，以便做CDC。CDC用来构建缓存视图模型，每5分钟以NDJSON推到对象存储做备份。家里服务器上另一个进程每隔几分钟恢复数据库，作为第二份备份，需要时能直接用。

我知道有Litestream这类东西，我想要进程内的、备份失败还能告警的方案。

[1] https://sqlite.org/jsonb.html

quotes.author: nchmy
quotes.en:
obviously the example is contrived, but it seems strange me that they are not storing the json in its own column - just extracting a single key from it and storing in a generated column. Why not do that in the app code if youre just going to discard the rest of the json?

Here's an example i saw yesterday from mariadb, which is improving its json support in its upcoming releases.

https://mariadb.com/docs/server/ha-and-performance/optimization-and-tuning/query-optimizations/virtual-column-support-in-the-optimizer#example

```
CREATE TABLE t1 (json_data JSON);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES('{"column1": 1234}'); 
INSERT INTO t1 ...
```

In order to do efficient queries over data in JSON, you can add a virtual column, and an index on that column:

```
ALTER TABLE t1
  ADD COLUMN vcol1 INT AS (cast(json_value(json_data, '$.column1') AS INTEGER)),
  ADD INDEX(vcol1);

```
quotes.zh:
例子显然是凑的，但他们不把JSON存在自己的列里、只抽一个键放进生成列，我觉得奇怪。如果你打算丢掉其余JSON，为什么不在应用代码里做？

昨天看到MariaDB的例子，它即将发布的版本在加强JSON支持。

https://mariadb.com/docs/server/ha-and-performance/optimization-and-tuning/query-optimizations/virtual-column-support-in-the-optimizer#example

```
CREATE TABLE t1 (json_data JSON);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES('{"column1": 1234}'); 
INSERT INTO t1 ...
```

要对JSON里的数据做高效查询，可以加一列虚拟列，再在上面建索引：

```
ALTER TABLE t1
  ADD COLUMN vcol1 INT AS (cast(json_value(json_data, '$.column1') AS INTEGER)),
  ADD INDEX(vcol1);

```

items.title: H5N1 bird flu in Australia: 20+ species infected since June
items.title_zh: H5N1自6月起在澳大利亚感染20余种动物，已确认逾350起事件
items.summary_zh: 澳大利亚广播公司：H5N1禽流感6月中旬首次在澳大利亚被检出，至8月下旬已有逾350起确认事件，含数次野生动物大规模死亡，超过20个物种检测呈阳性，从南极周边海鸟传到海滩再进入内陆水系。CSIRO确认的鸟类包括大凤头燕鸥、银鸥、小企鹅、澳洲鲣鸟、喜鹊、游隼等，哺乳动物已出现长鼻毛皮海狮、普通海豚和狐狸。悉尼大学兽医病理学家Rachael Gray称局面“相当压倒性”。西悉尼大学Julie Old说给大多数野鸟接种“几乎不可能”，疫苗需间隔三至四周打两针；目前只计划给维多利亚菲利普岛与圣基达约4万只小企鹅中的5000只接种。没有商业化的哺乳动物疫苗；CSIRO称尚无给海豹等鳍足类接种的具体计划。

quotes.author: Rachael Gray
quotes.en: It's pretty overwhelming at the moment. These animals, who we very much love and admire and respect … these animals are getting sick, they are suffering and then they are dying.
quotes.zh: 眼下相当压倒性。这些我们非常喜爱、钦佩也尊重的动物……它们在生病，在受苦，然后死去。

items.title: Monzo Stand-In
items.title_zh: Monzo Stand-In：用另一套系统扛住整朵云宕机
items.summary_zh: Monzo工程博客：主平台在AWS，备用Stand-In在GCP，跑另一套服务而不是同一份代码的热备，覆盖刷卡、取现、转账、查余额和冻卡。数据单向最终一致同步，Stand-In产生的“Advice”在主平台恢复后再原样回放；常驻成本约主平台的1%。2024年8月一次约一小时的大故障里，他们第一次对全部用户打开了全部Stand-In组件。HN上122赞、61评。名字借用支付行业的Stand-in processing（STIP）。

quotes.author: danpalmer
quotes.en:
I can't help but think this isn't the best idea, it raises so many questions. How does fail over work (it failed for me!), can you safely fail over, how does product think about the stack, is it funded well enough, how do you scale a system from zero to all traffic instantly, how do you effectively keep this environment warm, how do you determine which services are critical enough to be in it, how do you manage finding the bugs in two separate stacks, and so on and on and on.

It seems like it would be better to invest in a platform that is distributed across multiple failure domains. Some companies call this a cell architecture. For Monzo this might mean true multi cloud, but they already have bare metal services for bank integrations so they are already hybrid in some respects.

It's not the decision I would have made, and I'm not sure I agree with their reasoning, but I'll also admit that I have not run a bank, I don't know all their constraints, and there are some good tech folks at Monzo. That said, I am an SRE at Google so I'd like to think I'm not completely naïve here.

Edit: after reading in more detail I'm puzzled. The justification for Stand-In and not traditional scale-out is the difficulty of data consistency (agreed!), but then Stand-In is just eventually consistent anyway, and introduces sync problems in both directions. Admittedly I'm spoilt by Spanner, but I do wonder if Monzo is being bitten by past architecture choices here.
quotes.zh:
我忍不住觉得这不是最好的主意，问题太多了。故障切换怎么做（对我就失败过！）、能不能安全切、产品怎么看待这套栈、经费够不够、怎么把系统从零瞬间扩到全部流量、怎么把环境保持热备、怎么判定哪些服务关键到要放进去、怎么在两套栈里找bug，诸如此类。

看起来不如投资一套跨多个故障域的平台。有些公司叫单元架构。对Monzo来说这可能意味着真正的多云，但他们已经有银行对接的裸金属服务，某种程度上已经是混合的。

这不是我会做的决定，也不确定同意他们的理由，但我也承认我没运营过银行，不知道全部约束，Monzo也有不错的技术人。不过我是Google的SRE，希望自己在这儿不算完全天真。

编辑：再细读之后我更困惑了。不用传统横向扩展、改做Stand-In的理由是数据一致性难（同意！），可Stand-In本身也只是最终一致，还在两个方向引入同步问题。我承认被Spanner惯坏了，但还是怀疑Monzo是不是被过去的架构选择咬到了。

quotes.author: janpeuker
quotes.en: Minor thing but I do like they use the word "Stand In" here in the payments / financial sense of Stand-in processing (STIP), which is usually used when a bank is offline to keep essential services such as public transport working.
quotes.zh: 小事一桩，但我喜欢他们用“Stand In”这个词，取的是支付/金融里Stand-in processing（STIP）的意思，通常在银行掉线时用来维持公交等基本服务。
